cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've arranged a proper bin handover. I covered your holiday, not the rest of your life. You're taking over tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The neighbors only send the reminders to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll announce you as the contact. You can choose the wording; I want this transition running smoothly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stay in the group for the first week. I don't even know which bin goes Thursday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A supervised first week, exactly. I'll stay and tell you the color. You send 'I'll put it out Thursday' so everyone knows my handover worked.
